rules.name: osiris: Autonomous Agent Unauthorized Tool Execution Attempt (SYS-021 Gate)
rules.description: Detects an attempt by an autonomous AI agent, toolchain, or subagent to execute an unauthenticated payload or mutate system state without a cryptographically signed SYS-021 grant. The osiris runtime halts execution in-line prior to kernel dispatch.
false_positive_risks: Unenrolled developer testing scripts without generating a valid cryptographic grant.
response_actions: Verify operator public key enrollment in osiris trust root.
Forensically inspect process.command_line and process.hash.sha256 in Elastic SIEM.

rules.name: osiris: In-Flight Payload Bytecode or AST Digest Divergence
rules.description: Detects an in-flight mutation or race condition where the executable bytes presented to the runtime do not match the pre-signed grant SHA-256 digest (H_payload != SHA-256(code)). Indicates memory tampering, file replacement, or unauthorized script injection.

rules.name: osiris: Cryptographic Merkle Hash Chain Divergence (Root Log Tampering)
rules.description: Detects an irreconcilable hash-chain break in the local osiris audit ledger (H_n != SHA-256(H_{n-1} || Block_n)). Indicates an adversary or compromised root account attempted to rewrite, delete, or fabricate retroactive audit history.

technique.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

rules.name: osiris: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Signature Verification Failure (CNSA 2.0)
rules.description: Detects a block or telemetry transmission failing NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 lattice signature verification, or attempting an unauthenticated classical cryptographic algorithm downgrade. Enforces CNSA 2.0 quantum-resistant audit mandate.

rules.name: osiris: Hardware Noise Floor & Epistemic Calibration Drift
rules.description: Identifies when physical edge telemetry, quantum syndrome decoders, or sensor streams drift beyond the 1.11 pp RMS noise floor established by matched-pair A/A baseline controls. Prevents SOC false-positive storms caused by ambient thermal or RF fluctuations.

rules.name: osiris: Tactical Edge Disconnected Batch Reconciliation Anomaly
rules.description: Detects gaps, sequence skips, or nonces out-of-order when a forward-deployed edge enclave reconnects after disconnected operations (DIL) and bulk-dumps accumulated offline audit ledgers into central Elastic.
